title: Yusupov Egg, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Created in 1907, the Yusupov Egg is a remarkable combination of jewellery elegance and an ingenious clock design. Time is indicated by a serpent coiling around the composition, while enamel decoration and golden ornaments give the piece its distinctive sense of luxury. This silver collector coin by Mennica Polska translates that motif into miniature form, preserving the symbolism and decorative style of the famous Fabergé eggs. Complete your collection with a coin inspired by some of the world’s most celebrated jewellery masterpieces.
